user.title: Select Linn player
user.description: Select the Linn DSM (or another OpenHome player) whose playlist should be filled.

manual.title: Add player manually
manual.description: URL of the player's UPnP device description, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:55178/Ds/device.xml

servers.title: Select DLNA music servers
servers.description: Select the music servers (e.g. MinimServer, Asset UPnP, Linn/Kazoo Server) you want to play on {name}. Servers that were not discovered can be added by the URL of their device description (comma separated).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the player.
error.not_openhome: The device has no OpenHome Playlist service (not a Linn DS/DSM?).
error.cannot_connect_server: At least one server is unreachable or not a DLNA media server.
error.no_servers: Please select at least one music server.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the player.

data_description.qobuz_server: Server providing Qobuz via DLNA (e.g. upmpdcli or BubbleUPnP Server). Shown in the library card under “Qobuz”.
data_description.tunein_username: Your TuneIn username (no password needed). Your TuneIn favourites then appear in the radio section of the library card.

error.cannot_connect_server: At least one server is unreachable or not a DLNA media server.
error.no_servers: Please select at least one music server.

load_media.name: Load into Linn playlist
load_media.description: Loads a track, album, folder or playlist of a DLNA server into the Linn playlist.

media_content_id.name: Media ID
media_content_id.description: ID from the media browser (starts with dlnamusik://), a media-source:// ID or a URL.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Replace, append, play next or play now.

play.name: Start playback
play.description: Start playback after loading (default: for replace and play).

play_track.name: Play playlist track
play_track.description: Jumps to the given track of the Linn playlist and plays it.

track_id.name: Track ID
track_id.description: ID of the track in the Linn playlist (see the playlist card or the current_track_id attribute).

remove_tracks.name: Remove tracks from playlist
remove_tracks.description: Removes one or more tracks from the Linn playlist.

track_ids.name: Track IDs
track_ids.description: List of track IDs to remove.

move_track.name: Move track
move_track.description: Moves a track of the Linn playlist to a new position. If it is playing it restarts after the move.

track_id.name: Track ID
track_id.description: ID of the track in the Linn playlist.
